axes.concept: An inflatable entrance to the decorator’s workplace: a blue latex threshold, a tethered yellow foil balloon and a working plane that seats beside them.
axes.layout: Asymmetric two-plane stage: 0.78fr story/sculpture and 1.6fr working surface, with 32px separation. The working surface has a 72px upper entrance corner. Below 760px the story becomes a compact mast above the full-width work plane.
axes.navigation: Signed-in pages use an in-flow upper conveyor with an active station puck for Accounts, Roles and My account; account actions open a detail view. Authentication stays invitation-only; no carousel or bottom dock.
axes.typography: Embedded DejaVu Sans Condensed Bold Oblique is the 48–78px display voice; embedded Liberation Sans Regular/Bold handles 13–26px working copy. Large compressed italic words suggest filled latex under forward tension.
axes.density: Open stage with 34px desktop plane padding, 22px phone plane padding and 20px phone outer gutters; roster rows unfold their metadata on phone. 44px minimum buttons and 48px fields; no metric cards.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI buttons, inputs, Animate UI checkboxes, skeletons, Dialog, AlertDialog and DropdownMenu. Bespoke CSS latex gate, foil volume, tether, asymmetric working plane and station puck; native language and planning selectors.
axes.colour: Cobalt latex #1545cc and sunflower foil #ffcf49 on blue #d9e7fb; navy #10294f information. Dark stage #081d42 and work plane #102b56 with yellow actions and #f3f7ff text. Pictures semantic token roles retained; this is an explicitly proposed exploration palette.
axes.motion: Spatial seating rather than generic fading: gate rotates and expands, foil travels diagonally, tether uncoils, plane settles in perspective, display squares on a spring, rows seat laterally with 55ms offsets, status compresses, empty ring settles, foil sways gently on its tether after arriving. 800ms expressive stage, 480ms natural, 240ms subtle; 180ms control lifts/press. The 6s foil sway pauses offscreen, in hidden tabs and on sculpture hover. Reduced motion and still=1 show final positions.
